newsitem.title: PERU: Peru government modifies telephone charge rates.
newsitem.headline: Peru government modifies telephone charge rates.

text.p: The government's telecommunications regulatory body OSIPTEL announced Thursday its quarterly modification to its telephone charges with effect from June.
The minimum commercial rental rate would rise 2.7 soles ($1.00) to 42.04 soles per month, while the residential rate would rise 9.9 percent to 30.46 soles per month, OSIPTEL said in a statement.
Long-distance national call charges fell 0.65 percent to 0.612 sol per minute, while international calls dropped 2.46 percent to 3.66 soles.
Telefonica del Peru, controlled by Telefonica de Espana, has a monopoly on Peru's conventional telephone services until 1999.
